execution_note: Sequential model requests on a personal Windows desktop with other applications and development/verification processes active. Fixed order; no thermal or background-load control. Preliminary in-template evidence only.
warmup: One first-task call per calibration model; one actual-task call before each policy/ablation measurement. Excluded from observations.
